description.text: 1. Course and Purpose: The program is designed to teach spoken Chinese, and a taste of Chinese culture. It aims to improve learners’ communicative skills with oral Chinese and enable them to have a better and more in-depth knowledge of Chinese culture through personal experience. 2. Program Date and Duration: The program is offered for four weeks from January to February, July to August.Please note that we offer flexible program dates for a group of 10 or above. 3. Curriculum: Course TeachingHours (1TH=45min) Details CommunicativeSpokenChinese 20hours/week RefertoI-5 ChineseCulture TaiChi 40min/class,twice/week Calligraphy 2hrs/class,once/week CityTour EverySaturday 1:ForbiddenCity,Tian’anmnSaure,Qianmen 2:GreatWall 3:OlympicGreen、SummerPalace 4:TempleofHeaven Performance Everyotherweek Acrobatics PekingOpera 4.DetailsforChinese course Level1 (Beginner) Level2 (Lower-intermediate)

duration.text: The Chinese Language and Culture Study Program at Beijing University of Technology is a 4 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 430 USD/In total ￥ 3100 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1.All foreign citizens above 18 years old are welcome to join the program. 2.Application for summer program starts from March 1 and closes one week ahead of the program’s commencement. 3.Application for winter program starts from September 1 and closes one week ahead of the program’s commencement.
